expected_vs_observed.expected: Offsets improve fidelity while routing and composition remain limiting.

expected_vs_observed.interpretation: Position repair is necessary mechanistically but routing/composition and training distribution control utility.

expected_vs_observed.interpretation: Contextualization and task utility remain distinct from coordinate repair.
